note: Materialized into a temp dir at test time. Checking these files into skills/ directly would let pytest collect the fixture's own tests and would put a second .env.example inside the repo tree.

files.internal/handler/health.go:

func Health() string { return "ok" }
files.internal/service/order.go:

files.migrations/0001_init.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id text primary key);
files.Makefile:
help:
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:' Makefile

install-tools:
	go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest

build-api:
	go build -o ./bin/api ./cmd/api

run-api:
	go run ./cmd/api

test:
	go test ./...

lint:
	golangci-lint run

cover:
	go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...

migrate-up:
	migrate -path migrations up

name: ci

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
